title: Chang-I Tsai 蔡正一
content_html:
Born in 1954 at Qing-Shui, Taichung County. Graduated from National Taiwan Normal University, Oil Paint Major.

Past positions: Teacher at Wide Range Art Studio for 10 years teaching college bound students; Shih Hsin University teacher and Art Club Director; Nan Chiang Industrial & Commercial Senior High School, teach in Graphic Design; Ming Chuan University, teach in Commercial Design.

Current: Professional Artist; Director of Fun Year Art Gallery.

Solo Exhibitions: 1988 Da-Dia Art Center, Taipei; Taichung City Cultural Center, Taichung; 1990 InSian Gallery, Taichung; Modern Art Gallery, Taichung; 1991 InSian Gallery, Taipei; 1992 Modern Art Gallery, Taichung; Jin-Dian Art Center, Tainan; 1994 Taichung County Cultural Center, Taichung; Jin-Dian Art Center, Tainan; World Art Center, Kaohsiung; 1995 Chung-Ming Art Gallery, Taoyuan; 1997 WuChi Township Farmers’ Association Art Center, Taichung; Bai-Hong Art Gallery, Taoyuan; 1999 Celebrated Art Gallery, Kaohsiung; Asia Art Center, Taipei; Airiti Art Center, Taipei; 2000 Fun Year Art Gallery, Taichung; 2003 Fun Year Art Gallery, Taichung; 2005 Fun Year Art Gallery, Taichung; 2008 Fun Year Art Gallery, Taichung; 2012 Taichung City Seaport Art Center, Taichung.

Awards: 1973 Birthday of President Watercolor Competition, 3rd place; 1979 I Love Taipei Exhibition, Watercolor Excellence Award; Tai-Young 42nd Annual Exhibition, Selected Award; 1980 National Taiwan Normal University Teacher and Student Exhibition, Watercolor Excellence Award; Tai-Young 43rd Annual Exhibition, Excellence Award; National Oil Paint Exhibition, Excellence Award; 1982 Lion Art New Talent Award; National Oil Paint 6th Annual Exhibition; Tai-Young 45th Annual Exhibition, Selected Award; 1983 Taiwan Art 37th Exhibition, Selected Award; National Young Artist Print Exhibition, Selected Award; National College Student Art Exhibition, Excellence Award; National Taiwan Normal University Graduation Exhibition.

Website: http://funyearart.com/

 Archive
 

 

Born in 1954 at Qing-Shui, Taichung County. Graduated from National Taiwan Normal University, Oil Paint Major.

Past positions: Teacher at Wide Range Art Studio for 10 years teaching college bound students; Shih Hsin University teacher and Art Club Director; Nan Chiang Industrial & Commercial Senior High School, teach in Graphic Design; Ming Chuan University, teach in Commercial Design.

Current: Professional Artist; Director of Fun Year Art Gallery.

Solo Exhibitions: 1988 Da-Dia Art Center, Taipei; Taichung City Cultural Center, Taichung; 1990 InSian Gallery, Taichung; Modern Art Gallery, Taichung; 1991 InSian Gallery, Taipei; 1992 Modern Art Gallery, Taichung; Jin-Dian Art Center, Tainan; 1994 Taichung County Cultural Center, Taichung; Jin-Dian Art Center, Tainan; World Art Center, Kaohsiung; 1995 Chung-Ming Art Gallery, Taoyuan; 1997 WuChi Township Farmers’ Association Art Center, Taichung; Bai-Hong Art Gallery, Taoyuan; 1999 Celebrated Art Gallery, Kaohsiung; Asia Art Center, Taipei; Airiti Art Center, Taipei; 2000 Fun Year Art Gallery, Taichung; 2003 Fun Year Art Gallery, Taichung; 2005 Fun Year Art Gallery, Taichung; 2008 Fun Year Art Gallery, Taichung; 2012 Taichung City Seaport Art Center, Taichung.

Awards: 1973 Birthday of President Watercolor Competition, 3rd place; 1979 I Love Taipei Exhibition, Watercolor Excellence Award; Tai-Young 42nd Annual Exhibition, Selected Award; 1980 National Taiwan Normal University Teacher and Student Exhibition, Watercolor Excellence Award; Tai-Young 43rd Annual Exhibition, Excellence Award; National Oil Paint Exhibition, Excellence Award; 1982 Lion Art New Talent Award; National Oil Paint 6th Annual Exhibition; Tai-Young 45th Annual Exhibition, Selected Award; 1983 Taiwan Art 37th Exhibition, Selected Award; National Young Artist Print Exhibition, Selected Award; National College Student Art Exhibition, Excellence Award; National Taiwan Normal University Graduation Exhibition.

Website: http://funyearart.com/
